Title: Илон Маск официально стал богатейшим человеком планеты

Summary: 
On October 1, 2025, billionaire Elon Musk became the first person in history to have a net worth exceeding $500 billion, according to Forbes. As of 15:30 Eastern Time, his wealth was estimated at $499.1 billion, making him officially the richest person on Earth. Musk previously became the first person to reach $400 billion in net worth in December 2024, surpassing Larry Ellison by $150 billion. His wealth increased by approximately $9.3 billion on Wednesday following a 4% rise in Tesla shares, which nearly doubled in value since Musk announced in April 2025 his departure from the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) to focus more on Tesla. Forbes notes that Musk is on track to become the world’s first trillionaire.

Elon Musk’s net worth peaked above $400 billion in December 2024 after a surge in SpaceX’s valuation, but fell to roughly $385 billion in 2025, according to Bloomberg and other outlets. Larry Ellison overtook Musk as the world’s richest man, with a net worth of about $390 billion after Oracle’s stock rallied in September 2025; just days earlier his net worth had been $100 billion lower. Musk’s wealth is largely tied to his 12 % stake in Tesla (≈412 million shares) and 43 % stake in SpaceX (valued at $350 billion in December 2024). He pledged 58 % of his Tesla shares as collateral for $3.5 billion in loans and sold $40 billion of Tesla stock in 2022 to fund a $44 billion acquisition of Twitter (now X), whose value has dropped nearly 70 % as of August 2024. Musk also owns 54 % of xAI, valued at $50 billion in November 2024, and 43 % of SpaceX; the Boring Company is valued at about $5 billion. The article notes Musk’s political role: Trump announced in November 2024 that Musk and Vivek Ramaswamy would lead the unofficial Department of Government Efficiency, with Trump saying they 'will pave the way for my administration to dismantle government bureaucracy, cut excessive regulations, eliminate wasteful spending, and restructure federal agencies.' The piece lists the richest people according to Bloomberg, Forbes and other outlets.

Title: Texas' richest man set to be world's first half-trillionaire

Summary: 
Elon Musk, CEO of Tesla, reached a net worth of $500 billion on October 1, 2025, according to Forbes' Real-Time Billionaires tracker, making him the first person to achieve half a trillion dollars in wealth and positioning him as the world's first trillionaire in waiting. This milestone followed a nearly 4% rise in Tesla's stock price, which added an estimated $9.3 billion to his fortune. Musk, who became the first person worth $400 billion in December 2024, is $150 billion ahead of second-place Larry Ellison, co-founder of Oracle. Tesla’s stock has nearly doubled since Musk stepped back from his role in President Trump’s Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) in April 2025, following a 71% drop in Tesla’s profit, which prompted investor pressure to focus on the company. Musk also owns a 42% stake in SpaceX, valued at $168 billion (up from $350 billion in December 2024), and a 53% stake in xAI Holdings, worth $60 billion, following its merger with X in March 2025. Forbes estimates Musk could become the world’s first trillionaire before March 2033. He has held the top spot on Forbes’ list of richest Americans for four consecutive years and first became the world’s richest person in January 2021 with a net worth of nearly $190 billion.
